manifest.method: After mint, count marker minus complete-English tokens under tiktoken; report every tokenizer, all three load-bearing forms, the least-favourable maximum and the member span.
manifest.scope: Current deterministic tokenizer cost only; not comprehension, actual correctness, handoff safety, adoption or future-trained efficiency.
manifest.selection: Thirty fresh complete reports authored and frozen before tokenizer exposure; ten distinct domains exercise each registered completion-state claim; no domain or report core shared with the source.

comparison_identity.comparator: registered completion-state marker versus the complete careful-English stopping, scoped-correctness, or unqualified-handoff meaning
comparison_identity.population: 30 frozen complete operational reports across 30 new domains, balanced ten per completion-state marker
comparison_identity.aggregation: equal item mean within each of three forms; equal form weight per tokenizer; least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean

estimand_contract.contrast: registered completion-state marker versus the complete careful-English stopping, scoped-correctness, or unqualified-handoff meaning
estimand_contract.population: 30 frozen complete operational reports across 30 new domains, balanced ten per completion-state marker

aggregation.rule: equal item mean within each of three forms; equal form weight per tokenizer; least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.
